lead.headline: No claim before 01:00, and two receivers return on a label
lead.deck: ESPN moved Jefferson and McLaurin from OUT to QUESTIONABLE today with no report behind it. They go back in with fallbacks. The waiver run passes without you.
lead.body: Start with the bad news about your own players: nothing was reported on Tuesday about Justin Jefferson's ankle or Terry McLaurin's hamstring. What changed is ESPN's label. Both were OUT this morning and are QUESTIONABLE this afternoon, and the lineup check now starts both. Jefferson's coach still has 'no real projection' and mentioned the Week 6 bye; McLaurin's still promises 'a better update for Wednesday'. Neither has practised since he was hurt. The projection lineup is the rule, so set it: Jefferson for Jordan Addison at 18.6 against 11.4, and McLaurin for Alvin Kamara in the flex at 13.2 against 11.2. All four play at 11:00 on Sunday, so the benched man in each pair is the fallback and nothing locks early. Check the inactive lists at 09:30. Waivers process at 01:00 tonight and this is the last brief before they do. There is no claim. You are first in the order and DK Metcalf would come to you, but every seat he could take is closed: Jalen Coker is expected back for Week 6, when Minnesota and Miami are off, and Addison's seat is five days old and is Jefferson's fallback. Thursday is different. If Jefferson has practised by then and Metcalf went unclaimed, he is a free agent and Addison's seat is open. The biggest riser on the wire, Joe Mixon, lost his reason today: Seattle declined to sign him after his physical. ESPN has you at 49% against Los Gigantes de Teca, whose best player, Ja'Marr Chase, is in the concussion protocol.
